title: RobotStudio workflows and connector status
description: Explore RobotStudio workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.
html:
SoftwareUpcoming

ABB

RobotStudio

ABB RobotStudio supports offline programming and simulation for ABB robot systems.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Model an ABB robot cell

Use the selected part, stock, machine or cell layout. In the intended RobotStudio preview, model an ABB robot cell; the visible result is a process setup with work coordinates, resources and target geometry visible. Review orientation, reach, tooling and fixture assumptions before accepting or exporting it.

Program a virtual controller

Start from the chosen operations, tools or robot tasks. In the intended RobotStudio preview, program a virtual controller; the visible result is a generated path or production sequence over the same setup. Review clearance, collisions, limits, feeds and operation order before accepting or exporting it.

Validate cycle and reach

Begin with the simulated material removal, robot motion or process results. In the intended RobotStudio preview, validate cycle and reach; the visible result is a verification view with remaining stock, reach or cycle data exposed. Review collisions, code target, cycle time and safe human approval before accepting or exporting it.
